content: घनाघन {%a.%} .²1 Fond of slaughter, striking down; घनाघनः क्षोभणश्चर्षणीनाम् <ls>Rv. 10. 103. 1</ls>. .²2 Cruel, hurting, mischievous. .²3 Even, uniform, compact; संजातश्च घनाघनो जलधरः शीर्णश्च वायोर्जवात् <ls>Māl. 9. 39</ls>. .{@-नः@} .²1 Indra. .²2 A vicious elephant, or one in rut or intoxication. .²3 A thick or raining cloud; <ls>Bhāg. 3. 24. 7</ls>; घनाघनघटालोक-लीलाशालि-शिखादिभिः <ls>Śiva B. 26. 51</ls>. .²4 Mutual collision or contact.
